conduct, or is in the nature of impersonation in an electronic form, including 
artificially morphed images of such individual. 
 A time-bound grievance redressal mechanism. 
 
In case of non -compliance by intermediaries, rule 7 of these Rules becomes applicable and they 
are liable to lose their exemption from liability under section 79 of the IT Act, 2000. 
 
Further, „Police‟ and „Public Order‟ are State subjects as per the Seventh Schedule of the 
Constitution of India. The Law Enforcement Agencies at Centre and States, as appropriate, take 
legal action as per provisions of law against the violation of the Act.

Decline in Exports of Marine Products 
 
 
3457.  SHRI SANJAY RAUT:  
  
      Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  be pleased to 
state:  
 
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a decline in export of marine products;  
(b)  if so, the details of export of marine products since the last three years, State-wise; and  
(c) The details of steps taken or proposed to be taken by Government to help entrepreneurs 
to promote their brand internationally to increase export of marine products? 
 
ANSWER 
 
  THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING: 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
(a)   & (b) : While India’s marine products export ha ve slightly increased in rupee  terms during 
2019-20, there was  a decline during 2020 -21 due to global impact of Covid-19 pandemic. The 
State-wise details of the export of marine products during the last three years are furnished at 
Annexure. However, during the year 2021-22, the marine products exports stood at an all time high 
of USD 7.156 billion during April to February, 2021-22.  
(c): The Marine Products Export Development Authority (MPEDA), Department of    Commerce 
has been taking various steps to promote export of marine products from India to other countries 
including brand promotion of Indian fisheries products. These inter alia  include participation in 
various relevant trade fairs and exhibitions, organizing Virtual Buyer Seller Meets (VBSMs) with 
the importing countries for the benefit of the stakeholders. Further, MPEDA has been reaching out 
to the Indian Missions in selected importing countries for assistance to promote seafood exports 
from India. In addition, during COVID-19 pandemic, MPEDA formulated COVID-19 guidelines 
for seafood sector and issued advisories to exporters to avoid COVID-19 related contamination. 
Further, the Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and  Dairying 
during 2020-21 has rolled out a flagship scheme “Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana 
(PMMSY) with highest ever investment of Rs. 20050 crore in the fisheries sector for 
implementation during a period of five years i.e. 2020-21 to 2024-25, in all States/Union 
Territories. PMMSY intends to address critical gaps in fish production, productivity, quality, 
technology, post-harvest infrastructure and management, modernization and strengthening of value 
chain, reduction of post-harvest losses, traceability etc. In order to enhance India’s export 
competitiveness, PMMSY supports for quality fish production, species diversification, promotion 
of export-oriented species, branding, standards and certification, training and capacity building, 
creation of post harvest infrastructure with emphasis on seamless cold chain and development of 
modern fishing harbours and fish landing centers, etc.   In addition, to address the critical 
infrastructure requirements of fisheries and aquaculture sectors, the Department of Fisheries, GoI 
during 2018-19 has created the Fisheries and Aquaculture Infrastructure Development Fund (FIDF) 
with a total fund size of Rs 7522.48 crore to provide  concessional finance to States/UT and private 
sector.

LIVESTOCK AFFECTED BY DISEASES 
 
 
3460. SHRI NEERAJ DANGI: 
 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & DAIRYING 
 be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is aware of the fact that a large number of animals have been 
badly affected due to various diseases; 
 
(b
) if so, whether the number of suicides by farmers are on a rise due to poverty induced 
by shortage of livestock; 
 
(c)  
if so, the details thereof; and  
 
(d) the details of facilities provided by Government to the States to grow the livestock 
population in the country during the last three years? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
THE 
MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & DAIRYING 
(SHRI PARSHOTTAM  RUPALA) 
 
 
(a):  Government is aware of diseases among animals like Foot & Mouth Disease (FMD), 
Brucellosis, Hemorrhagic Septicemia (HS), Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD), Black Quarter 
(BQ), Classical Swine Fever (CSF), New Castle Disease, Peste des Petits Ruminants 
(PPR), etc. Central Government provides financial assistance for contr ol of major animal 
diseases including economically important, exotic, emergent and zoonotic diseases. 
Assistance is also provided for establishment and strengthening of mobile veterinary units 
for providing veterinary services at farmer’s doorstep.  
 
315

 
(b) & (c): There are no such reports 
 
(d): During the last three years, Government of India has taken the following initiatives to 
support States/UTs in areas related  to animal health, animal production, animal nutrition, 
conservation of indigenous bovine breeds, breed improvements, feed and fodder 
development through Departmental schemes across the country which helps in growth of 
healthy livestock population:  
1
. Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM): For development and conservation of indigenous 
bovine breeds 
 
2. National Programme for Dairy Development (NPDD): To enhance quality of milk 
and milk products and increase share of organized procurement, processing, value 
addition and marketing, productivity enhancement through nutritional interventions. 
 
3. Dairy Processing and Infrastructure Development Fund (DIDF): Creation/ 
strengthening/ modernization of Milk Chilling & Processing Plants, Value added 
Product making facilities, Energy efficiency infrastructure, Training facilities, Cattle 
Feed Plant, etc. 
 
4
. Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme(LH&DCP): Central 
Government provides financial assistance for eradication and control of major 
diseases through vaccination as well as providing veterinary services through mobile 
veterinary units (MVUs).  
 
5
. Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund (AHIDF): Incentivizing 
establishment of dairy processing and value addition, meat processing and value 
addition, animal feed plant and technologically improved breed multiplication 
infrastructure by individuals, Farmer Producer Organisation, Micro Small and 
Medium Enterprises, and Private Companies. 
 
6
. National Livestock Mission (NLM) : Entrepreneurship development and breed 
improvement in poultry, sheep, goat and piggery including feed and fodder 
development. 
 
7. Supporting Dairy Cooperatives and Farmer Producer Organizations: Assisting 
State Dairy Cooperative Federations by providing soft working capital loan. 
 
8. Livestock Census and Integrated Sample Survey:  Publishing species wise Breed -
wise report based on the latest Livestock Census at aggregate as well as segregated 
level so as to enable policy decisions.

and Lakshadweep Islands was 21.75 lakh tones. 
(b) and (c): The marine capture fish production of India has been fluctuating over the years. The 
Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying  is committed for optimum utilization of 
fishery resources and notified the ‘ National Policy on Marine Fisheries, 2017’ to guide the 
responsible and sustainable fishing. Besides, Government of India promotes sustainable fishing and 
has issued advisories from time to time to coastal States/UTs
 for preventing juvenile fishing and ban 
on destructive fishing practices for ensuring  sustainable fishing. Paired bottom trawling or bull 
trawling and use of artificial LED lights in fishing are  banned in the Exclusive Economic Zone of 
India. The uniform ban on fishing in the Indian EEZ is also implemented for a period of 61 days , 
from 15th April to 14 th June on the East Coast and from 1 st June to 31 st July on the West Coast  to 
ensure sustainable fishing . Moreover, t he Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal 
Husbandry and Dairying is implementing a flagship scheme namely “Pradhan Mantri  Matsya 
Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)” with highest ever estimated investment of Rs. 20050 crore in fisheries 
sector for a period of 5 years with effect from the financial year 2020 -21. Under the PMMSY  the 
activities such as  sea ranching, mariculture and seaweed cultivation  are promoted as additional 
livelihood for fishers and coastal communities so as to reduce fishing pressure and enhancing

NATION WIDE RULES FOR SLAUGHTER HOUSES 
 
3463: DR. VIKAS MAHATME: 
Will the Minister of FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the amount of meat consumed in the country, State- wise and type- wise; and 
 
(b) Whether Government is planning to introduce nationwide rules and regulations for the 
slaughter houses in the country so as to provide safe, clean and hygienic  meat to the 
consumers, if so, the details thereof 
 and  if not, the reasons therefor ? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING  
      (SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA)  
           
(a) The Central Government does not maintain the amount of meat consumed in the country 
state-wise. However, State wise meat produced in the country is at Annexure 1.  
 
(b
)  No Sir. Science based standards for articles of food including meat and to regulate their 
manufacture, storage,distribution, sale and import to ensure availability of safe and 
wholesome food for the consumers are already in place under the Food Safety Standards 
Regulations. 
 
The standards of meat and meat products including definition of ‘animal’ are prescr ibed 
by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) under regulation 2.5 of Food 
Safety and Standards  (Food Product Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011.  
FSSAI has also prescribed detailed guidelines for slaughter houses under sub-regulation 
2.1.2 (1) (5), Schedule IV; Part IV of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing and 
Registration) Regulations, 2011. The guidelines cover slaughter-houses and slaughtering 
of animals which includes specific hygienic and sanitary practices to be followed by 
Food Business Operators engaged in manufacture, processing, storing and selling of Meat 
and Meat Products; pre & post handling of animals; and precautions for animal welfare.   
State/UT Governments have also prescribed additional guidelines for slaughter-houses 
319

       
and slaughtering of animals.All Food Business Operators have to comply with such 
prescribed standards guidelines. 
Implementation and enforcement of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and Rules and 
Regulations made thereunder, along with that of any additional guidelines prescribed by 
States/UTs, primarily rests with the State/ UT Governments. Regular surveillance, 
monitoring and inspection is undertaken by State/UT Governments to check compliance 
of the prescribed standards and guidelines. In case non-compliance, penalaction is 
initiated under the provisions of the FSS Act, 2006. 
              
Further, the Central Government has framed Prevention of Cruelty to Animal  
(Slaughter House) Rules, 2001 (amended in 2010) prescribing the Standards for 
establishment of Slaughter Houses to reduce the pain and sufferings of the animals to be 
slaughtered. As per the said rules, the animals proposed for meat production need to be 
slaughtered in the licensed slaughter houses.

REGARDING SAFETY OF WOMEN ON LOCAL SHUTTLE TRAINS 
(a) to (c) : ‘Police’ and ‘Public Order’ are State subjects under the Seventh Schedule to the 
Constitution of India and, as such, State Governments are responsible for prevention, detection, 
registration and investigation of crime and maintaining law and order etc. on Railways through their 
law enforcement agencies viz. Government Railway Police (GRP)/District Police.  However, 
Railway Protection Force (RPF) supplements the efforts of GRP/District Police to provide better 
protection and security of passenger area and passengers and for matters connected therewith.  Cases 
of crime under Indian Penal Code (IPC) are registered and investigated by the concerned Government 
Railway Police. Whenever any information about status of crime on Railways is sought, State GRP is 
requested to provide information. Based on the data provided by GRP, it is informed that only one 
case is registered regarding crime against women passengers in local/shuttle trains across Kanpur – 
Delhi route (via Tundla Junction) during last year i.e. 2021. No case is registered in respect of crime 
against women passengers in local/shuttle trains across Delhi –
 Agra route during last year i.e. 2021. 
 
Further, the following steps are being taken by the Railways in coordination with GRP for safety and 
security of women passengers in trains including local shuttle trains and at railway stations:-  
1. On vulnerable and identified routes/sections, trains are escorted by Railway Protection Force 
in addition to trains escorted by Government Railway Police of different States daily. The 
train escorting parties have been briefed to keep extra vigil on the lady passengers travelling 
alone, ladies coaches en-route and at halting stations.  
2. Zonal railways have been instructed for deployment of proper combined strength of male & 
female RPF/RPSF personnel in train escort parties, to the extent possible.  
3. Railway Help Line number 139 is operational (24x7) over Indian Railways for security 
related assistance to passengers in distress.

(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
(a) Indian Railways has introduced mechanized cleaning at major stations to maintain proper 
hygiene, cleanliness and sanitation within station premises. The mechanized cleaning is carried 
out using high pressure water jets, mechanised floor scrubber, walk behind automatic scrubber 
dryer, battery operated ride on scrubber, vacuum cleaner, flippers, wet and dry vacuum cleaner 
etc., along with the requisite material and manpower. 
(b) Efforts are also made for mechanized cleaning on non-conducive surface. Ride on road

-conducive surfaces. Furthermore cleaning of non-conducive surfaces are generally done

using tools like brooms, hand scrubbers, wet mops, wipers etc with recommended 
chemicals/cleaning agents. 
(c) Indian Railways’ Vision 2020 targets prioritisation of sanitation and waste management. 
Following have been envisaged as thrust area for Indian Railways: 
 Study of each station for its peculiarities to achieve near-zero-waste by adopting the principle 
of reduction, recycle and re-use. 
 Infrastructure and amenities like water supply, drainage, sewerage, washable aprons, properly 
designed platforms and 'pay and use toilets' maintained by competent agencies along with 
user awareness campaigns. 

 Coordination with city authorities. 
 Enhancement of train cleanliness by retrofitting all coaches with discharge free green toilets. 
 Mechanized cleaning at maintenance terminals. 
 Onboard housekeeping and en-route mechanized cleaning at Clean Train Stations. 
 Maximum recycling of water. 
 Professional assistance for pest and rodent control. 
(d) Scrubbers as mentioned in Standard Bid Document (SBD) for mechanised cleaning 
includes scrubber machines having twin movement i.e. rotary action of scrubber and translational 
movement and the same are being used in mechanised cleaning system over Indian Railways.

QUESTION NO. 3501 BY SHRI AYODHYA RAMI REDDY ALLA ANSWERED IN RAJYA 
SABHA ON 01.04.2022 REGARDING ASSURANCES UNDER NATIONAL RAIL PLAN 
(a) The plan of 100% electrification of Railway tracks is being executed in mission mode. Out of 
64,689 route km of Broad Gauge routes of Indian Railways including Konkan Railway, 49,105 
route km (75.91%) have been electrified upto February, 2022.  
 
As on 01.04.2021, 251 Multi-tracking  projects of total length of 23,915  Km, costing approx. `2.94 lakh 
crore are in different stages of planning/sanction/execution, out of which 4,430 Km length has been 
commissioned and an expenditure of `86,041 crore has been incurred upto March, 2021 . Completion of 
these multi tracking projects will reduce congestion.  Zonal Railway wise details of Railway projects 
including cost, expenditure and outlay are made available in public domain on Indian Railways web site 
i.e. www.indianrailways.gov.in >Ministry of  Railways > Railway  Board  > About  Indian  Railways  > 
Railway Board Directorates >Finance (Budget) >Rail Budget/Pink Book (Year)> Railway wise Works 
Machinery and Rolling Stock Programme. 
 
(b) Indian Railways have prepared a National Rail Plan (NRP) for India – 2030. The Plan is to 
create a ‘future ready’ Railway system by 2030.  The NRP is aimed to formulate strategies based 
on both operational capacities and commercial policy initiatives to increase modal share of the 
Railways in freight to 45%. The objective of the Plan is to create capacity ahead of demand, 
which in turn would also cater to future growth in demand right up to 2050 and also increase the 
modal share of Railways to 45% in freight traffic and to continue to sustain it. To achieve this 
objective all possible financial models including Public Private Partnership (PPP) are being 
considered.

pajamas, lungi and dhoti etc. by powerlooms has increased in the past years;  
 
(b) if so, the details of the appropriate action being taken against such powerlooms; and

Production) Act, 1985 to protect handlooms weavers from encroachment of the powerloom and mill

1. स्‍र्ार्धअप इंणिया कायध योजना : 16 र्नवरी  2016 को  स्‍र्ार्ाअप  इोंकिया के  किए एक  काया  योर्ना  आर ों भ की  गई  थी।

सहायता  और  प्रोत्‍साहन " तथा  "उद्योग-शैक्षकणक  भागीदारी  और  इोंक्‍यूबेशन "। इस  काया  योर्ना  में देश  में एक  वाईब्रेंर्  
स्‍र्ार्ाअप  इकोकसस्‍र्म  के  सृर्न  के  किए सरकारी  सहायता , स्‍कीमोों और  प्रोत्‍साहनोों की  शुरूआत  करने  की  पररकल्‍ पना

2. स्‍र्ार्धअप्‍स  के णलए णनणर्यों का कोष  (एफएफएस ) स्‍कीम: सरकार  ने  स्‍र्ार्ाअप्‍ स  की  कनधी यन  सोंबोंधी आवश्‍यकताओों 
को  पूरा  करने  के  किए 10,000 करोड  रुपए  के  कॉपास  के  साथ  एफएफएस  स्‍थाकपत  ककया  है। िीपीआईआईर्ी  एफएफएस  
की  कनगरानी  एर्ेंसी है तथा  भारतीय  िघु उद्योग कवकास  बैंक (कसिबी) इसकी  प्रचािन  एर्ेंसी है। 10,000 करोड  रुपए

को  बढावा  कदया है।

सरकार  ने  स्‍र्ार्ाअप्‍ स  बौद्धिक सोंपदा सोंरक्षण (एसआईपीपी ) की  शुरूआत  की  है र्ो  स्‍र्ार्ाअप्‍ स  को  पोंर्ीक ृ त सुकवधा  
प्रदाताओों के  र्ररये  उपयुक्‍त  आईपी  कायााियोों में क े वि साोंकवकधक शुल्‍क  का  भुगतान  करक े  पेर्ेंर्  किर्ाइन  तथा  व्‍यापार

क्या  वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक :

(ग) सरकार  द्वारा भारत  क  कनयाषत  क े न्द्र (एक्सप र्ष  हब) के  रूप  में कवककसत  करने  के  किए उठाए जा

उत्तर 
वाणिज्य और  उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
 
(क): प्रत्यक्ष  कवदेशी कनवेश एफडीआई क  बढावा देने के  किए सरकार  ने कनवेशक  अनुक ू ि नीकत  बनाई है 
कजसमें रणनीकतक  रूप  से महत्‍वपूणष क्षेत् ं  क  छ डकर  अकिकांश  क्षेत्  स्वत: अनुम दन मागष के  तहत  
100 प्रकतशत  एफडीआई के  किए खुिे  हैं। इसक े  अिावा, एफडीआई संबंिी नीकत  की  कनरंतर  आिार  
पर  समीक्षा  की  जाती  है ताकक  भारत  का  आकर्षक  और  कनवेश अनुक ू ि स्थि बने रहना  सुकनकित  
ककया  जा सक े । शीर्ष  उद्य ग चैंबसष, संघ ं, उद्य ग समूह ं के  प्रकतकनकिय ं  और  अन्य संगठन ं सकहत  
कहतिारक ं  के  साथ परामशष  करक े  नीकत  में बदिाव ककए  जाते  हैं। हाि ही में सरकार  ने कवकभन्न क्षेत् ं  
में अनेक  सुिार  ककए  हैं। कसफ ष कपछिे एक  वर्ष  में बीमा, रक्षा , पेर् र  कियम और  प्राक ृ कतक  गैस, 
द ू रसंचार  आकद जैसे क्षेत् ं  में एफडीआई नीकत  में सुिार  शुरू  ककए  गए हैं। 
 
सरकार  ने कनवेश क  आसान बनाने, नवप्रय ग क  बढावा देने, सवषश्रेष्ठ अवसंरचना  का  कनमाषण करने  
और  कवकनमाषण, कडजाइन तथा  नवप्रय ग के  किए भारत  क  एक  क ें द्र बनाने के  किए ‘मेक  इन इंकडया’ 
पहि की  शुरूआत  की  है। इसक े  अिावा, अंतरराष्ट् र ीय सहय ग क  बढावा देने और  देश में कवदेशी 
कनवेश क  प्र त्साकहत  करने  के  किए मंत्ािय ं , राज्य  सरकार ं  और  कवदेश ं में भारतीय  कमशन ं के  
माध्यम से कनवेश आउर्रीच  कायषकिाप  ककए  जाते  हैं।  
 
(ख): ऐसी क ई  सूचना उपिब्ध नहीं है।

उत्तर 
इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य मंत्री (श्री  राजीि चंद्रशेखर)  
 
(क ): इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  और  आईटी मंत्रालय ने  मंत्रालय के  प्रमुख कायशक्रमों  की  प्रभािी ननगरानी

डैशबोडश  तक  अनभगम  सािशजननक डोमेन  में उपलब्ध  है और  सभी के  नलए  खुला  है। स्माटशबोडश ललक  
(https://meity.dashboard.nic.in)पर  उपलब्ध  है, और  यह एमआईटीिाई पोटशल  
(www.meity.gov.in) का  नहस्सा है, नजसक े  नलए  नहट की  संख्या की  ननगरानी  की  जाती है । 
 (ख) :  मंत्रालय ने  सािशजननक  आउटरीच  कायशक्रम  के  माध्यम से 3 अक्टूबर 2019 को  प्रदशशन  
स्माटशबोडश लॉन्च  ककया  है और  सोशल  मीनडया सनहत मीनडया में भी व्यापक रूप  से प्रचाररत ककया  
गया था। डैशबोडश  को एमआईटीिाई पोटशल  के  होम पेज पर  भी प्रमुखता से प्रचाररत ककया  जाता है। 
(ग): मंत्रालय के  संबंनधत कायशक्रम  प्रभागों द्वारा बाईस प्रमुख योजनाओं /गनतनिनधयों के  आंकडे  
मानसक, त्रैमानसक और  िार्षिक आधार  पर  स्माटश बोडश पर  अद्यतन ककए  जा रहे  हैं। ननयनमत  रूप  से

ii.  ईपयोगकतााओं  के  नलए ईनक े  डेस्कटॉप , मोबाआल /स्माटा  फोन  को  सुरनक्षत  करने  और  क़िसशग 
हमलों को  रोकने  के  नलए सुरक्षा  युनियााँ प्रकानशत  की  जाती हैं । 
iii.  सटा -आन  साआबर  स्िच्छता क ें र  (बॉटनेट  सफाइ  और  मालिेयर  निश्लेषण क ें र ) प्रचानलत करता

करता  है । 
iv.  सटा -आन  एक  स्िचानलत  साआबर थ्रेट एक्सचेंज  प्लेटफॉमा का  प्रचालन  सकक्रय खतरे  को  कम  
करने  की  कारािाइ  के  नलए निनभन्न क्षेत्रों के  संगठनों  के  साथ  सकक्रय  रूप  से  चेतािननयां  
एकनत्रत करने , निश्लेषण करने  और  साझा  करने  के  नलए करता  है । 
v. सरकार ने  ऄनुप्रयोगों/बुननयादी  ढांचे  को  सुरनक्षत  करने  और  ऄनुपालन  के  नलए मुख्य सूचना  
सुरक्षा  ऄनधकाररयों  ( सीअइएसओ ) की  प्रमुख भूनमकाओं  और  नजम्मेदाररयों  के  संबंध  में 
कदशाननदेश  जारी  ककए  हैं । 
vi.  सटा -आन  अइटी ऄिसंरचना  को  सुरनक्षत  करने  और  साआबर  हमलों को  कम  करने  के  संबंध  में 
सरकार  और  महत्िपूणा क्षेत्र के  संगठनों  के  नेटिक ा /नसस्टम  प्रशासकों  और  मुख्य सूचना  सुरक्षा  
ऄनधकाररयों  ( सीअइएसओ ) के  नलए ननयनमत  प्रनशक्षण कायाक्रम  अयोनजत करता  है। िषा 
2020 और  2021 के  दौरान  क्रमशः 708 और  5169 प्रनतभानगयों को  शानमल  करते  हुए क ु ल 
15 और  19 प्रनशक्षण कायाक्रम  अयोनजत ककए  गए । 
vii.  साआबर  खतरों  का  मुकाबला  करने  के  नलए खतरे  के  पररदृश्य और  सिोत्तम प्रथाओं पर  
जागरूकता  पैदा  करने  के  नलए सटा -आन  द्वारा िररष्ठ प्रबंधन और  मुख्य सूचना  सुरक्षा  
ऄनधकाररयों  ( सीअइएसओ ) के  नलए ननयनमत  रूप  से  टेबल टॉप ऄभ्यास  अयोनजत ककए  
जाते हैं। फरिरी, 2022 तक  सटा -आन  द्वारा जागरूकता  ननमााण  के  नलए सरकारी  और  
सािाजननक क्षेत्र के  संगठनों  को  शानमल  करते  हुए 24 ऐसे  टेबल टॉप ऄभ्यास  ककए  गए । 
viii. सटा -आन  ने  ईद्योग और  नशक्षा जगत के  सहयोग  से  देश में नागररकों  के  साथ -साथ  तकनीकी  
साआबर  समुदाय  के  नलए निनभन्न कायाक्रमों  और  गनतनिनधयों के  अयोजन  के  माध्यम से  
ऄक्टूबर 2021 के  दौरान  साआबर  सुरक्षा  जागरूकता  माह  मनाया।  जागरूकता  ऄनभयान , 
िीनडयो और  पोस्टर  प्रकानशत  करना  और  साआबर  सुरक्षा  प्रश्नोत्तरी सनहत  गनतनिनधयों को  
पूरी  तरह  से  ऑनलाआन  प्रनशक्षण प्लेटफॉमा और  सोशल  मीनडया  चैनलों  पर  अयोनजत ककया  
जाता  है । 
ix.  सटा -आन  ने  8 फरिरी 2022 को  ऄपने  अनधकाररक  सोशल  मीनडया  हैंडल और  िेबसाआटों  के  
माध्यम से  साआबर  सुरक्षा  जागरूकता  ऄनभयान  चलाकर  'सुरनक्षत  आंटरनेट  कदिस' मनाया  । 
x.  आलेक्ट्रॉननकी और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय ( एमइअइटीिाइ) सूचना  सुरक्षा  जागरूकता

3440.   डा. सी. एम. रमेश : 
   
 क्या  इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क)    क्या  रूस  और  यूक्र े न के  बीच चल रहे  युद्ध  के  कारण  अधधचालक  नचपों के  उत्पादन पर  प्रभाव 
पडेगा, यकद हााँ, तो तत्संबंधी  ब्यौरा क्या  है;  
(ख)      क्या  इसका  हमारे  ऑटोमोबाइल उद्योग पर  प्रनतक ू ल प्रभाव पडेगा क्योंकक  पहले ही ऐसे 
नचप्स की  कमी  के  कारण  नए वाहनों  के  नलए लम्बे समय के  नलए इंतजार  करना  पड रहा  है और  
इसक े  पररणामस्वरूप  देश में चाप पनहया वाहनों  की  नबक्री में तेजी से नगरावट  आई है, यकद हााँ, तो 
तत्संबंधी  ब्यौरा क्या  है?    
उत्तर 
इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य मंत्री (श्री राजीव  चंद्रशेखर) 
 
(क ): रूस -यूक्र े न संघषध ने  सेमीक ं डक्टर   उद्योग सनहत कई  क्षेत्रों में आपूर्तत श्रृंखलाओं को  प्रभानवत 
ककया  है। संघषध का  ननयॉन  और  हेक्साफ्लोरोबुटाडीन  गैसों की  आपूर्तत पर  नवशेष प्रभाव पड सकता  
है, जो सेमीक ं डक्टर  नचप्स के  ननमाधण  के  नलए एक  आवश्यक तत्व हैं क्योंकक  इनका  उपयोग नचप 
उत्पादन के  नलए नलथोग्राफी प्रकक्रयाओं में ककया  जाता है। यूक्र े न और  रूस  ननयॉन  और  
हेक्साफ्लोरोबुटाडीन  गैसों के  प्रमुख स्रोत हैं। वैनिक  सेमीक ं डक्टर   उद्योग पहले से ही कोनवड  अवनध  
के  दौरान  सामने  आए  आपूर्तत श्रृंखला व्यवधानों  के  कारण  कमी  का  सामना  कर  रहा  है। रूस -यूक्र े न 
संघषध अनतररक्त व्यवधान  पैदा कर  सकता  है और  सेमीक ं डक्टर   की  आपूर्तत श्रृंखला को  प्रभानवत कर  
सकता  है। 
 
(ख): सेमीक ं डक्टर  नचप की  कमी  ने  दुननया  भर  में कई  उद्योगों को  प्रभानवत ककया  है नजसमें ऑटो 
और  उपभोक्ता इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  उद्योग सबसे अनधक  प्रभानवत क्षेत्रों में से  हैं । यह कमी  सबसे पहले 
कोनवड -19 महामारी  के  बाद लॉकडाउन  और  प्रनतबंधों  के  कारण  सामने  आई। आपूर्तत पक्ष की  
समस्या मांग पक्ष की  समस्या में तब्दील हो गई है क्योंकक  अथधव्यवस्थाएं ठीक  होने लगी हैं नजससे 
नवनभन्न क्षेत्रों में इलेक्ट्रॉननक  वस्तुओं  की  खपत बढ़ गई है। वैनिक  नचप की  कमी  के  पीछे क ु छ प्रमुख 
कारण आपूर्तत श्रृंखला में व्यवधान , इलेक्ट्रॉननक  नवननमाधण  की  भौगोनलक  एकाग्रता, नडनजटल और  
इलेक्ट्रॉननक उत्पादों की  मांग में वृनद्ध  और  वैनिक  स्तर पर  नडनजटल अंगीकरण  हैं। यूक्र े न में संघषध 
अनतररक्त व्यवधान  पैदा कर  सकता  है और  सेमीक ं डक्टर   की  आपूर्तत श्रृंखलाओं को  प्रभानवत कर  
सकता  है और  ऑटोमोबाइल क्षेत्र सनहत इलेक्ट्रॉननकी   उद्योग को और  अनधक  बानधत  कर  सकता  है।

तथानप, सरकार  समग्र सेमीक ं डक्टर  इकोनसस्टम के  ननमाधण  के  अपने  महत्वपूणध उद्देश्य पर  भी बहुत 
ध्यान  क ें कद्रत कर  रही  है और  यह सुनननित  करती  है कक  यह बदले में भारत  के  तेजी से बढ़ते 
इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  नवननमाधण  और  नवाचार  इकोनसस्टम को  उत्प्रेररत करे।  इसक े  अलावा, इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  
और  सेमीक ं डक्टसध में आत्मननभधरता  की  इस दृनि को  माननीय  प्रधानमंत्री  की  अध्यक्षता  में क ें द्रीय 
मंनत्रमंडल द्वारा और  गनत दी गई थी, नजसमें सेमीकॉन  इंनडया कायधक्रम  को  हमारे  देश में 
सेमीक ं डक्टर  और  नडस्प्ले नवननमाधण   इकोनसस्टम के  नवकास  के  नलए क ु ल 76,000 करोड  रुपये  के  
पररव्यय के  साथ मंजूरी  दी गई थी। इस कायधक्रम  का  उद्देश्य सेमीक ं डक्टसध , नडस्प्ले नवननमाधण  और  
नडजाइन  इकोनसस्टम में ननवेश  करने  वाली क ं पननयों  को  नवत्तीय सहायता प्रदान करना  है। यह 
वैनिक  इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  मूल्य श्रृंखलाओं में भारत  की  बढ़ती उपनस्थनत का  मागध प्रशस्त करने  का  काम  
करेगा  ।

3441.   श्री रामक ु मार  िमाा: 
   
 क्ट्या आलेक ् ‍ट्रॉनिकी और  सूचिा प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बतािे की  क ृ पा  करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क)    िेश में आलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिक निनिमााताओं के  नलए ईत्पािि अधाररत  प्रोत्साहि (पीएलअइ) योजिा

(ग)      आस योजिा के  नलए सरकार द्वारा अबंरित का  गइ ऄिुमानित धिरानश  ककतिी है, और

ईत्तर 
आलेक ् ‍ट्रॉनिकी और  सूचिा प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य  मंत्री (श्री राजीि  चंिशेखर) 
 
(क ): भारत  सरकार  का  लक्ष्य भारत  को  ऄपिी अत्मनिभार भारत  अर्थिक िीनतयों के  नहस्से के  रूप  
में आलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिकी  के  नलए िैनिक मूल्य श्रृंखला में एक  महत्िपूर्ा निजाआि और  निनिमाार्  क ें ि बिािा  
है । आसक े  नहस्से के  रूप  में, हम ऄपिे आलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिकी आको -नसस्िम को  व्यापक और  सुिृढ़ कर  रहे  हैं। 
कोनिि-19 पश्चात िैनिक व्यिसाय और  व्यापार िातािरर्  में िैनिक क ं पनियां, अपूर्थत श्रृंखला 
जोनखमों को  कम  करिे  के  नलए ऄपिे निनिमाार्  स्िािों में निनिधता लािे की  कोनशश  कर  रही  हैं। 
 
राष्ट्रीय आलेक्ट्ट्रॉनिकी िीनत, 2019 ( एिपीइ 2019) नजसमें नचपसेि सनहत मुख्य संघिकों को

2016 से तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या है, यकद नहीं , तो आसक े  क्या कारण  हैं; और   
(ग)         क्या सरकार  के  पास हाआनिड वॉरफ े यर की  नस्थनत से ननपटने  की  िमता है?    
 
ईत्तर 
आलेक ्‍ट्रॉननकी और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य मंत्री (श्री राजीव  चंद्रशेखर) 
 
(क ) और  ( ख): सरकार  नवनभन्न साआबर  सुरिा  खतरों से पूरी  तरह  पररनचत  और  जागरूक  है। 
भारतीय  क ं प्यूटर अपातकालीन  प्रनतकिया दल ( सटष-आन ) को  भारत  में साआबर  सुरिा  की  
घटनाओं  पर  नज़र रखने  और  ननगरानी  करने  का  काम  सौंपा गया है । 
 
सटष-आन   ने  सूनचत ककया  है कक  वषष  2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 और  2021 के  दौरान  
सरकारी  संगठनों से संबंनधत िमशः क ु ल 5461 , 33514, 70798, 85797, 54314 और  
48285 साआबर सुरिा  घटनाएं  हुइ हैं। 
 
भारतीय  साआबर स्पेस पर  साआबर हमले करने  के  नलए समय-समय पर  प्रयास ककए  जाते हैं। यह 
देखा गया है कक  हमलावर  दुननया  के  नवनभन्न नहस्सों में नस्थत क ं प्यूटर प्रणाली से छेडछाड करते  हैं 
और  हमले करने  के  नलए ईपयोग की  जाने  वाली वास्तनवक प्रणाली की  पहचान  नछपाने  के  नलए 
छद्म तकनीक  और  नछपे हुए सवषर  का  ईपयोग करते  हैं । 
 
636

नवश्लेनषत और  भारतीय  क ं प्यूटर अपातकालीन  प्रनतकिया दल (सटष-आन ) को  ईपलब्ध कराए  गए 
लॉग के  ऄनुसार , ईन  क ं प्यूटरों के  आंटरनेट  प्रोटोकॉल (अइपी) पते जहां से हमलों की  ईत्पनत्त हुइ 
प्रतीत होती है में ऄल्जीररया, िाजील, चीन , फ्ांस, जमषनी , हांगकांग , आंडोनेनशया , नीदरलैंड , 
ईत्तर कोररया , पाककस्तान, रूस , सर्बबया, दनिण कोररया , ताआवान , थाइलैंड, ट्यूनीनशया, तुकी , 
संयुक्त राष्ट्र ऄमेररका , नवयतनाम  अकद जैसे नवनभन्न देश शानमल हैं । 
  
637

सटष-आन , ऄंतरराष्ट्रीय सटष, नवदेशी संगठनों  और  सेवा प्रदाताओं के  साथ-साथ कानून  प्रवतषन 
एजेंनसयों के  साथ सहयोग करता  है, काम  करता  है और  घटना  प्रनतकिया ईपायों का  समन्वय 
करता  है । 
 
(ग): आस मंत्रालय के  पास ऐसी कोइ  सूचना  ईपलब्ध नहीं  है । 
 
हालांकक, भारत  सरकार  ने  हाआनिड खतरों  सनहत साआबर खतरों  से प्रभावी ढंग से ननपटने  के  
नलए ईपाय ककए  हैं, नजनमें ऄन्य बातों के  साथ-साथ शानमल हैं: 
 
i.  सरकार  ने  क ें द्र सरकार  के
 सभी मंत्रालयों/नवभागों, राज्य/संघ राज्य िेत्रों की  सरकारों  
और  ईनक े  संगठनों  द्वारा साआबर  हमलों और  साआबर  अतंकवाद  से ननपटने  के  नलए 
साआबर  संकट  प्रबंधन योजना  ( सीसीएमपी) तैयार  की  है, आसमें साआबर  चैनलों  के  
माध्यम से हाआनिड खतरों  और  प्रभाव को  भी शानमल ककया  गया है। आसक े  ऄलावा, 
िेत्रीय संकट  प्रबंधन योजनाओं  के  नवकास  और  कायाषन्वयन में सहायता के  नलए 
कदशाननदेश  दस्तावेज और  टेम्पलेट प्रकानशत ककए  जाते हैं।  सीसीएमपी  का  ईद्देश्य 
रणनीनतक  ढांचे की  स्थापना करना  और  ककसी  साआबर -संकट  से ईबरने  हेतु तैयार  
करने , प्रनतकिया देने  और  िनतपूर्बत समन्वय करने  के  कायों  संबंधी मागषदशषन  करना  
है।  
ii.  सटष-आन   मंत्रालयों, नवभागों, राज्यों और  संघ राज्य िेत्रों और  महत्वपूणष संगठनों  के  
नलए साआबर सुरिा  खतरे  के  पररदृश्य के  बारे  में ईन्हें संवेदनशील  बनाने  के  नलए 
ननयनमत  रूप  से कायषशालाओं  का  अयोजन  करता  है, नजसमें हाआनिड प्रभाव के  
साआबर  वैक्टर शानमल हैं। यह ईन्हें साआबर  संकट  प्रबंधन योजना  तैयार  करने  और  
कायाषनन्वत करने  में सिम बनाता  है ऄब तक  क ु ल 128 कायषशालाएं  अयोनजत की  जा 
चुकी  हैं आनमें से वषष 2021 के  दौरान  31 सीसीएमपी कायषशालाएं   अयोनजत की  गइ 
हैं ।  
iii. सरकारी  और  महत्वपूणष िेत्रों में संगठनों  की  साआबर  सुरिा  संबंधी नस्थनत और  तैयारी  
के  अकलन को  सिम करने  के  नलए साआबर सुरिा  मॉक  निल और  टेबल टॉप ऄभ्यास 
ननयनमत  रूप  से अयोनजत ककए  जाते हैं नजसमें हाआनिड आन््लुएनन्सन साआबर  वैक्टर 
शानमल हैं। सटष-आन  द्वारा ऐसे 64 ऄभ्यास अयोनजत ककए  गए हैं नजनमें  नवनभन्न 
राज्यों और  िेत्रों के  820 संगठनों  ने  भाग नलया।

3450.   श्री देरेक  ओब्राइन: 
   
 क्या  इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क)    क्या  सरकार  ने  उस एप का  संज्ञान नलया  है नजसने  मुनललम  मनहलाओं  की  नीलामी  कर  उन् ‍हें 
लनक्षत  ककया  था, यकद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या  है;  
(ख)      इन  एपों के  नवरूद्ध क् ‍या काररवाई  की  गई है, तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या  है; और    
(ग)      क् ‍या सरकार  इन  घटनाओं  की  पुनरावृनत्त को  रोकने के  नलए  दीघरकानलक  कदम  उठा रही  है, 
यकद हां, तो तत्संबंधी ब्यौरा क्या  है?    
 
उत्तर 
इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी राज्य मंत्री (श्री राजीव  चंद्रशेखर) 
 
(क ) और  (ख): सरकार  यह सुनननित  करने  के  नलए  प्रनतबद्ध है कक  भारत  में इंटरनेट  सभी 
उपयोगकतारओं के  नलए  खुला , सुरनक्षत और  नवश्वसनीय और  जवाबदेह है। जैसे-जैसे इंटरनेट  का  
नवलतार  होता है और  नागररकों  के  नलए  कई  लाभ  प्रदान करता  है, सरकार  क ु छ उपयोगकतारओं द्वारा 
क ु छ सोशल  मीनडया/माध्यलथ प्लेटफॉमों  के  दुरुपयोग  के  कारण उपयोगकतारओं के  नुकसान  की  बढ़ती 
घटनाओं  से भी अवगत है, नजसमें मनहलाओं  और  बच्चों के  नखलाफ  अपराध  भी शानमल  हैं। 
 
मनहलाओं  के  नखलाफ  अपमानजनक  और  दुभारवनापूणर इरादे  वाले  दो ऐसे ऐप, जो सरकार  के  संज्ञान 
में आए थे, उन्हें "गीट हब" नामक एक  ओपन -सोसर प्लेटफॉमर पर  होलट ककया  गया था। दोनों  ऐप ने  
कनथत  तौर  पर  सोशल  मीनडया प्लेटफॉमर से मनहलाओं  के  प्रोफाइल को  उठाया और  कनथत  सामग्री 
को  बढ़ावा देने  के  नलए  नववटर  का  इलतेमाल  ककया  गया। 
 
भारत  के  संनवधान  की सातवीं अनुसूची  के  अनुसार  'पुनलस ' और  'लोक  व्यवलथा' राज्य के  नवषय हैं। 
कानून  प्रवतरन एजेंनसयां लागू  कानून  के  प्रावधानों के  अनुसार  कानूनी  काररवाई  करती  हैं। तत्काल  
मामले  में भारतीय  क ं प्यूटर आपात प्रनतकिया दल   ( सीईआरटी -इन ) ने  सेवा प्रदाताओं के  साथ 
समन्वय ककया  और  जांच को  सुनवधाजनक  बनाने के  नलए  कानून  प्रवतरन एजेंसी को  तकनीकी  
जानकारी  प्रदान की।

(ग): मनहलाओं  के  नखलाफ  अपराधों  सनहत साइबर अपराधों  से ननपटने  के  नलए  एक  समनन्वत तरीक े  
से तंत्र को  मजबूत करने  के  नलए , क ें द्र सरकार  ने  नवनभन्न नहतधारकों  के  परामशर से कई  उपाय ककए  
हैं, नजनमें  अन्य बातों के  साथ-साथ ननम्ननलनखत  शानमल  हैं: 
(i)  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी (आईटी) अनधननयम , 2000  में मनहलाओं  से संबंनधत अपराधों सनहत 
प्रचनलत साइबर  अपराधों  से ननपटने  के  प्रावधान ककया  गया हैं। अनधननयम  की  धारा  66ड., 
67, और  67क में शारीररक  गोपनीयता  के  उल्लंघन  और  इलेक्ट्रॉननक  रूप  में अश्लील/यौन -
लपष्ट सामग्री को  प्रकानशत करने  या प्रसाररत करने  के  नलए  दंड और  जुमारना का  प्रावधान 
ककया  गया है। इसक े  अलावा  भारतीय  दंड संनहता की  धारा  354ग और  354घ में साइबर  
बुललग  और  साइबर  लटाककग  के  नलए  सजा का  प्रावधान ककया  गया है। 
(ii)  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी ( मध्यवती कदशाननदेश  और  नडनजटल  मीनडया आचार संनहता) 
ननयमावली , 2021 माध्यलथों के  उपयोगकतारओं को  सशक्त बनाता  है और  सोशल  मीनडया 
प्लेटफॉमर को उपयोगकतारओं की  सुरक्षा के  नलए  जवाबदेह बनाता  है। ननयमावलीमें  अन्य 
बातों के  साथ ननम्ननलनखत  का  प्रावधान ककया  गया है

3458.   डा. वी. लिवादासन: 
 
    क्या मत्स्यपािन, पिुपािन और डेयरी मोंत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे  वक: 
 
(क) विवभन्न प्राक ृ वतक आपदाओं और  समुद्र में मत्स्यन के दौरान  अपनी जान गंिाने िाले मछ ु आरों की 
संख्या वकतनी है; 
(ख)  क्या सरकार  उनक े पररिारों  के वलए कोई राहत  योजनाए ं ला रही  है; और  
(ग)  यवद हां, तो िर्ष 2017 से संवितररत धनरावश  का िर्ष-िार ब्यौरा क्या है और  उन लोगों की िर्ष-
िार संख्या वकतनी है वजन्हें उक्त धनरावश  प्राप्त हुई? 
 
उत्तर 
मत्स्यपािन, पिुपािन और डेयरी मोंत्री  
(श्री परि त्तम रूपािा ) 
 
 (क) से (ग): आपदा प्रबंधन और  राहत  की प्राथवमक वजम्मेदारी राज्य सरकारों  की है और  क ें द्र 
सरकार  इस संबंध में उनक े प्रयासों में सहायता प्रदान करती  है। विवभन्न प्राक ृ वतक आपदाओं में और  
समुद्र में मत्स्यन के दौरान  अपनी जान गंिाने िाले मछ ु आरों का डेटा राज्य स्तर पर  रखा  जाता है। 
भारतीय  तटरक्षक बल क ें द्र/राज्य के प्रावधकाररयों के साथ वमलकर  समुद्र में मछ ु आरों के जीिन को 
बचाने के वलए प्राक ृ वतक आपदाओं के दौरान  सिेक्षण और  बचाि अवभयान चलाता है। मत्स्यपालन 
विभाग, भारत  सरकार  समुद्र में मछ ु आरों की सुरक्षा को सिोपरर महत्व देता है और  अपनी विवभन्न 
योजनाओं और  कायषक्रमों के अंतगषत वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करता है। प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य संपदा योजना 
(पीएमएमएसिाई), के अंतगषत मत्स्यपालन विभाग, भारत  सरकार  राज्य और  संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों के मछ ु आरों 
के वलए सुरक्षा वकट, मत्स्यन पोतों पर  संचार  और  ट रैवक ं ग उपकरणों , संभावित मत्स्यन क्षेत्र (पीएफजेड) 
उपकरणों  आवद के वलए वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करता  है। पीएमएमएसिाई के अंतगषत, 2020 -21 और  
2021-22 के दौरान , 51.80 करोड़ रुपए  की पररयोजना  लागत पर  14800 संचार और ट रैवक ं ग उपकरण , 
8.94 करोड़ रुपए की पररयोजना लागत पर 1351 सुरक्षा वकट और 1.10 करोड़ रुपए  की पररयोजना  लागत 
पर  1000 पीएफजेड उपकरणों  की राज्यों/ संघ राज्य क्षेत्रों को मंजूरी  दी गई है। मछ ु आरों के वलए 
सुरक्षा वकट प्रदान करने  और  मत्स्यन पोतों पर  ट रैवक ं ग उपकरण प्रदान करने  के वलए तत्कालीन क ें द्र 
प्रायोवजत योजना नीली क्रांवतिः मात्स्यत्स्यकी क्षेत्र का एकीक ृ त विकास और  प्रबंधन के अंतगषत वित्तीय 
सहायता भी दी गई थी। तवमलनाडु की 4997 मत्स्यन नौकाओं पर ट र ांसपोंडर लगाने क े  वलए 2019-20 क े  
दौरान 18.01 करोड़ रुपए की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान की गई।

खाद्य सुरिा  और  मानक  अकधकनयम, 2006 और  उसक े  तहत  बनाए गए कनयमोां और  कवकनयमोां के  साथ -साथ

(ग)  क्या क ृ लर्ष उपज की अस्वीकायष रूप से बबाषदी हो रही है लजसका अन्यथा प्रसंस्करण में उपयोग 
लकया जा सकता है; 
(घ) यलद हां, तो मंत्रालय द्वारा और अलधक पररयोजनाओं को अनुमोलदत करने क े  ललए क्या -क्या 
प्रयास लकए गए हैं तालक देश में बबाषदी को कम लकया जा सक े  और प्रसंस्करण क े  प्रलतशत को 
बढाया जा सक े; और  
(ङ) पीएमक े एसिाई क े  तहत सृलजत बैकिर्ष और फारिर्ष ललंक े ज का  ब्यौरा क्या है?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) और (ख): अब तक, आंध्र प्रदेश में स्थथत क ु ल 42 पररयोजनाओं को प्रधानमंत्री लकसान संपदा 
योजना क े  तहत संबंलधत घटक योजनाओं की शुरुआत क े  बाद से सहायता क े  ललए संस्वीक ृ लत दी गई है 
और 15 पररयोजनाओं को कायाषत्मक बनाया गया है लजसक े  पररणामस्वरूप अनुमालनत 28663 प्रत्यक्ष 
और अप्रत्यक्ष रोजगार क े  अिसर प्राप्त हुए हैं। कायाषत्मक पररयोजनाओं का लििरण अनुबांध-1 में लदया 
गया है। 
(ग): आईसीएआर - कटाई क े  उपरांत अलभयांलत्रकी एिं प्रौद्योलगकी संथथान (सीआईपीएचईटी) लुलधयाना 
द्वारा लकए गए अध्ययन "भारत में प्रमुख फसलों और िस्तुओं की मात्रात्मक फसल और  फसलोत्तर हालन 
का आकलन" क े  अनुसार िर्षष 2014 क े  थोक मूल्ों पर 2012 -13 क े  उत्पादन आंकडों का उपयोग 
करते हुए राष्ट् र ीय स्तर पर प्रमुख क ृ लर्ष उत्पादों की फसल और फसलोत्तर हालन का अनुमालनत िालर्षषक 
मूल् 92 ,651 करोड रुपये था। अध्ययन में लिलभन्न फलों की हालन का अनु मान 6.7-15.88% और लिलभन्न 
सस्ियों की हालन का अनुमान 4.58-12.44% था।  
(घ): प्रसंस्करण/परररक्षण अिसंरचना क े  संिधषन सलहत खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र की समग्र िृस्ि और 
लिकास को सुलनलित करने क े  ललए खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की अम्ब्रेला योजना - 
प्रधानमंत्री लकसान संपदा योजना (पीएमक े एसिाई), क ें द्र प्रायोलजत प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण 
उद्यम उन्नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योजना और क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र उत्पादन ललंक्र् प्रोत्साहन योजना 
(पीएलआईएसएफपीआई) को कायाषस्ित कर रहा है।  
(ड.): पीएमक े एसिाई की बैकिर्ष और फॉरिर्ष ललंक े ज सृजन योजना तहत देश भर में पूरी की गई 
पररयोजनाओं का लििरण अनुबांध-2 में लदया गया है।

3471. श्री एस. सेल्वागनबेथी:  
 क्या खाद्य प्रसांस् िरण उद्योग मांत्री यह बताने की क ृ पा करेंगे लक:  
(ि)  क्या खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग अभी भी क ु छ लिकट बाधाओं का सामना कर रहा है लिनक े  तत्काल 
लनिारण की आिश्यकता है तालक भारत लिकलसत देशों से बराबरी कर सक े  िहां उत्पाद क े  
मूल्यिधधन और उसक े  भंडार और उपयोग होने तक की अिलध को बढाने क े  ललए उसक े  एक 
बडे लहस्से का प्रसंस्करण लकया िाता है;  
(ख)  यलद हां, तो सरकार द्वारा इस संबंध में क्या कदम उठाए गए हैं; और  
(ग)  यलद नहीं, तो इसक े  क्या कारण हैं?    
 
उत्तर 
 
खाद्य प्रसांस्करण उद्योग राज्य मांत्री 
(श्री प्रहलाद कसांह पटेल) 
 
(ि) और (ख): िी, हााँ। खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र क े  सामने आने िाली बाधाओं से लनपटने और देश भर में 
इसक े  समग्र िृद्धि और लिकास को सुलनलित करने क े  ललए खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग मंत्रालय 
(एमओएफपीआई) क ें द्रीय क्षेत्र की अम्ब्रेला योिना-प्रधानमंत्री लकसान संपदा योिना (पीएमक े एसिाई), 
क ें द्रीय प्रायोलित प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यम उन्नयन (पीएमएफएमई) योिना और क ें द्रीय 
क्षेत्र उत्पादन ललंक्ड प्रोत्साहन योिना (पीएलआईएसएफपीआई) को कायाधद्धित कर रहा है। 
पीएमक े एसिाई की घटक योिनाओं क े  अंतगधत एमओएफपीआई खाद्य प्रसंस्करण 
उद्योग/यूलनटों/पररयोिनाओं की स्थापना क े  ललए व्यद्धियों, लकसानों, लकसान उत्पादक संगठनों 
(एफपीओ), उद्यलमयों, सहकारी सलमलतयों , सलमलतयों, स्वयं सहायता समूहों (एसएचिी), लनिी क ं पलनयों 
और क ें द्र/राज्य क े  सािधिलनक उपक्रमों आलद को अनुदान सहायता क े  रूप में अलधकांशतः  क्र े लडट 
ललंक्ड लित्तीय सहायता (पूंिीगत सद्धिडी) प्रदान करता है।  
मंत्रालय पीएमएफएमई योिना क े  अंतगधत सूक्ष्म खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्यमों की स्थापना/उन्नयन क े  
ललए लि त्तीय, तकनीकी और व्यािसालयक सहायता प्रदान करता है। पीएलआईएसएफपीआई का लक्ष्य 
खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षेत्र में चैंलपयन ब्ांड बनाकर खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्षमता क े  लिस्तार की सुलिधा प्रदान करना 
है।   
(ग): प्रश्न नहीं उठता।

र्टक योजनाओं क े  तहत एमओएफपीआई खाद्य प्रसंस्करण उद्योग/इकाइयों/पररयोजनाओं की स्थापना

सहायता समूहों, लनजी क ं पलनयों और क ें द्रीय/राज्य क े  सावघजलनक उपक्रमों आलद को अनुदान सहायता 
क े  रूप में अलधकांशतः  क्र े लडट ललंक्ड लवत्तीय सहायता (पूंजीगत सद्धिडी) प्रदान करता है।

2024-25 तक पांच विों क े  दौरान 10,000 करोड़ रुपये क े  पररव्यय क े  साथ क्र े लडट ललंक्ड सद्धिडी क े

कर रहा है। पीएमएफएमई योजना क े  तहत अब तक झारखंड को 4.43 करोड़ रुपये की रालश जारी की 
जा चुकी है।

सेवाननवृत् त कममचाररयों के ग्रेड-पे में रुरिपूर्म कमी को सुधारना 
 
3520. डा. अशोक बाजपेयीीः 
 क्या वस्त्र मररी यह बताने की कृपा करेंगे ककीः 
(क)  क्या व्यय नवभाग को वस्त्र सनमनत के सेवाननवृत्त कममचाररयों के ग्रेड-पे में रुरिपूर्म कमी और उनसे 
की गई रुरिपूर्म वसू ी को ठीक करने के न ए ननदेश कदये गए हैं नजस सरबरध में सवोच्च न्याया य 
द्वारा कदनारक 5.3.2020 को 2020 के सीए 2016 के तहत ननर्मय कदया गया है; 
(ख) व्यय नवभाग ने इस माम े को तार्ककक पररर्नत तक पहुँचाने और सेवाननवृत्त कममचाररयों को 
उनकी बकाया धनरानश प्रदान करने के न ए सरबरनधत मररा यों, नवशेषकर इस मररा य को 
नहदायत देने के न ए अब तक क्या ककया है; और  
(ग) क् या इस सरबरध में कायाम य ञापापन (मएम) जारी ककया गया है, यकद हाुँ, तो कायाम य ञापापन के 
कायमकारी भाग के घिक क्या है?  
 
 
 
उत् तर  
वस्‍त र राज् य मररी  
(श्रीमती दशमना जरदोश) 
(क): जी नहीं। वषम 2012-13 के न ए वस्त्र सनमनत के  ेखाओं पर सीएजी  ेखापरीक्षा द  द्वारा की गई 
 ेखापरीक्षा तथा कार्ममक एवर प्रनशक्षर् नवभाग, भारत सरकार से प्राप्त स्‍तपष्टीकरर् के आधार पर, वस्त्र 
सनमनत के कममचाररयों/पेंशनभोनगयों के 118 माम ों की पहचान सुधारात्मक कारमवाई करने के न ए की 
गई थी, नजसमें ननयमानुसार उनके उच्चतर ग्रेड वेतन को पार ग्रेड वेतन में सुधारा गया था। इसके 
पररर्ामस्‍तवरूप, उच्चतर ग्रेड वेतन रुरिपूर्म तरीके से प्रदान करने के कारर् कममचाररयों/पेंशनभोनगयों को 
ककए गए अनधक भुगतान को सभी उनचत कोड  औपचाररकताओं का पा न करने के बाद वस्‍त र सनमनत 
द्वारा रोक कदया गया था। माननीय सवोच्च न्याया य ने कदनारक 5.3.2020 के फैस े के तहत ग्रेड पे में 
किौती और वसू ी के नख ाफ नवनभन्न आवेदकों द्वारा दायर सभी एसए पी को ननरस्‍त त कर कदया था, और 
भारत सरघ द्वारा दायर अपी  को अनुमनत दी थी। 
(ख) और (ग): प्रश् न ही नहीं उठता।

THE VICE-CHAIRMAN (DR. SASMIT PATRA):  Question No. 331; 
Shri Iranna Kadadi ji.  
Biofuel Policy 2018 
*331. SHRI IRANNA KADADI: Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GA S
be pleased 
to state:
(a) whether Government has introduced the new Biofuel Policy in 2018;
(b)
the details of the Letters of Intent ob tained in furtherance of the Policy t o
manufacture b
iofuels, categorised by type of biofuel;
[ 4 April, 2022 ]
13

(c) whether the country is on track to achie ve target of ethanol blende d petrol as
mentioned in the Biofuel Policy, 2018 and, if not, the details thereof;
(d) the details of the budget allocated for implementing the Biofuel Policy, 2018
and the amount expended till now, State-wise; and
(e) whether the rules to be formulated und er the policy are in the final stages of
drafting and, if not, the reasons therefor?
THE MINISTER OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS (SHRI HARDEEP SINGH 
PURI): (a) to (e) A Statement is laid on the Table of the House. 
Statement 
(a) Government has notified the National Policy on Biofuels-2018 on 4th June
2018.   The Government is promoting biofuels  with the broader objectives of reducing 
import dependency, generating employme nt, providing better remuneration to 
farmers, promoting better waste management practices, etc.   
(b) Public Sector Oil Marketing Comp anies (OMCs) float annual tender for
ethanol procurement under the Ethanol Bl ended Petrol (EBP) Programme. For the 
ongoing Ethanol Supply Year (ESY) 2021-22,  OMCs tendered a requirement of 459 
crore litres and based on the offers receiv ed, OMCs have released Letter of Intents 
(LoIs) for procurement of 416.33 crore litres of ethanol as on 27.03.2022.   
OMCs have also floated Expression of Interests (EoI) to shortlist interested 
bidders who wish to enter into Long-term Off-take Agreement for supply of ethanol in 
the deficit States from upcoming dedicated ethanol plants.   
Used Cooking Oil (UCO) has been identified as a potential raw material for 
biodiesel production and public sector OM Cs have floated EoIs for procurement of 
Biodiesel produced from UCO across 300 lo cations. OMCs have received offers for 
setting up 61 plants with a production capacity of approximately 36 crore litres per 
annum for manufacturing Biodiesel from UCO. 
With a view to promote the use of Co mpressed Bio Gas (CBG) as automotive 
fuel, Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) initiative has 
been launched on 01.10.2018 under which OMCs have been inviting EoI from potential 
entrepreneurs to produce CBG.  SATAT initiative envisage s for establishment of 5000 
14
[RAJYA SABHA]

CBG plants across the country with an es timated production of 15 MMT CBG per 
annum by 2023-24. Till 28.2.20 22, Oil PSUs have released LoIs for establishment of 
3160 CBG plants for procurement of CBG.  
(c) The National Policy on Biofuels-2018 provides an indicative target of 20%
blending of ethanol in petrol and 5% blendi n g  o f  B i o d i e s e l  i n  d i e s e l  b y  2 0 3 0 .   T h e  
Government has advanced the target of 20% blending of ethanol in petrol to 2025-
2026.  For the ongoing Ethanol Supply Ye ar (ESY: 2021-22), OMCs have already 
achieved 9.6% blending as on 27th March, 2022.   
(d) In March, 2019, Government has notified the “Pradhan Mantri JI-VAN
(Jaiv Indhan-Vatavaran Anukool fasal awashesh Nivaran) Yojana ” for providing 
financial support to integrated bio-ethanol projects for setting up second generation 
ethanol projects in the country using ligno cellulosic biomass and other renewable 
feedstock. The total financial outlay for the scheme is Rs. 1969.50 crore for the period 
2018-19 to 2023-24.  Financial assistance of Rs. 150 crore each to the four bio-
ethanol projects and Rs. 15 crore to one demonstration project being set up by Oil 
CPSEs have been approved under the PM JI-VAN Yojana. 
(e) The biofuel policy comprehensively covers various aspects of biofuel
program including strategy and approach, interventions and enabling mechanism, 
role of stake holders, institutional mech anism, international cooperation, etc. 
Pursuant to this policy, relevant procedures and processes have been put in place.

Biofuel Policy 2018 
 
*331. SHRI IRANNA KADADI: Will the Mini ster of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
be pleased to state: 
  
(a)   whether Government has introd uced the new Biofuel Policy in 2018; 
(b) the details of the Letters of Intent obtained in furtherance of the Policy to  
manufacture biofuels, categorised by type of biofuel; 
(c) whether the country is on track to achie ve target of ethanol blended petrol as 
mentioned in the Biofuel Policy, 2018 and, if not, the details thereof; 
(d)  the details of the budget allocated for implementing the Biofuel Policy, 2018 
and the amount expended till now, State-wise; and 
(e) whether the rules to be formulated und er the policy are in the final stages of 
drafting and, if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
[4 April, 2022]
13

THE MINISTER OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS (SHRI HARDEEP SINGH 
PURI): (a) to (e) A Statement is laid on the Table of the House. 
 
Statement 
 
(a)   Government has notified the National Policy on Biofuels-2018 on 4th June 
2018.   The Government is promoting biofuels  with the broader objectives of reducing 
import dependency, generating employme nt, providing better remuneration to 
farmers, promoting better waste management practices, etc.   
 
(b)  Public Sector Oil Marketing Comp anies (OMCs) float annual tender for 
ethanol procurement under the Ethanol Bl ended Petrol (EBP) Programme. For the 
ongoing Ethanol Supply Year (ESY) 2021-22,  OMCs tendered a requirement of 459 
crore litres and based on the offers receiv ed, OMCs have released Letter of Intents 
(LoIs) for procurement of 416.33 crore litres of ethanol as on 27.03.2022.   
 
OMCs have also floated Expression of Interests (EoI) to shortlist interested 
bidders who wish to enter into Long-term Off-take Agreement for supply of ethanol in 
the deficit States from upcoming dedicated ethanol plants.   
 
Used Cooking Oil (UCO) has been identified as a potential raw material for 
biodiesel production and public sector OM Cs have floated EoIs for procurement of 
Biodiesel produced from UCO across 300 lo cations. OMCs have received offers for 
setting up 61 plants with a production capacity of approximately 36 crore litres per 
annum for manufacturing Biodiesel from UCO. 
 
With a view to promote the use of Co mpressed Bio Gas (CBG) as automotive 
fuel, Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) initiative has 
been launched on 01.10.2018 under which OMCs have been inviting EoI from potential 
entrepreneurs to produce CBG.  SATAT initiative envisage s for establishment of 5000 
CBG plants across the country with an es timated production of 15 MMT CBG per 
annum by 2023-24. Till 28.2.20 22, Oil PSUs have released LoIs for establishment of 
3160 CBG plants for procurement of CBG.  
 
 (c) The National Policy on Biofuels-2018 provides an indicative target of 20% 
blending of ethanol in petrol and 5% blendi n g  o f  B i o d i e s e l  i n  d i e s e l  b y  2 0 3 0 .   T h e  
Government has advanced the target of 20% blending of ethanol in petrol to 2025-
14
[RAJYA SABHA]

2026.  For the ongoing Ethanol Supply Ye ar (ESY: 2021-22), OMCs have already 
achieved 9.6% blending as on 27th March, 2022.   
 
 (d) In March, 2019, Government has notified the “Pradhan Mantri JI-VAN 
(Jaiv Indhan-Vatavaran Anukool fasal awashesh Nivaran) Yojana ” for providing 
financial support to integrated bio-ethanol projects for setting up second generation 
ethanol projects in the country using ligno cellulosic biomass and other renewable 
feedstock. The total financial outlay for the scheme is Rs. 1969.50 crore for the period 
2018-19 to 2023-24.  Financial assistance of Rs. 150 crore each to the four bio-
ethanol projects and Rs. 15 crore to one demonstration project being set up by Oil 
CPSEs have been approved under the PM JI-VAN Yojana. 
 
(e) The biofuel policy comprehensively covers various aspects of biofuel 
program including strategy and approach, interventions and enabling mechanism, 
role of stake holders, institutional mech anism, international cooperation, etc.  
Pursuant to this policy, relevant procedures and processes have been put in place.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
STARRED QUESTION No. 331 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 04 th April, 2022 
 
Biofuel Policy 2018 
 
*331 SHRI IRANNA KADADI:  
 
 
 
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether Government has introduced the new Biofuel Policy in 2018; 
 
(b) the details of the Letters of Intent obtained in furtherance of the Policy to 
manufacture biofuels, categorised by type of biofuel; 
 
(c) whether the country is on track to achieve target of ethanol blended petrol as 
mentioned in the Biofuel Policy, 2018 and, if not, the details thereof; 
 
(d) the details of the budget allocated for implementing the Biofuel Policy, 
2018 and the amount expended till now, State-wise; and 
 
(e) whether the rules to be formulated under the policy are in the final stages of 
drafting and, if not, the reasons therefor? 
  
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF PETROLEUM & NATURAL GAS  
 (SHRI HARDEEP SINGH PURI) 
 
 (a)  to  (e) :      A Statement is laid on the Table of the House. 
 
****** 
 
 
 
 
 
  
  
2

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PART (a) TO (e) OF THE 
RAJYA SABHA STARRED QUESTION No. 331 TO BE ANSWERED ON 
04.04.2022 REGARDING BIOFUEL POLICY 2018 ASKED BY SHRI 
IRANNA KADADI. 
 
(a)   Government has notified the National Policy on Biofuels-2018 on 4th June 
2018.   The Government is promoting biofuels with the broader objectives of 
reducing import dependency, generating employment, providing better 
remuneration to farmers, promoting better waste management practices, etc.   
(b)  Public Sector Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) float annual tender for 
ethanol procurement under the Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Programme. For 
the ongoing Ethanol Supply Year (ESY) 2021-22, OMCs tendered a 
requirement of 459 crore litres and based on the offers received, OMCs have 
released Letter of Intents (LoIs) for procurement of 416.33 crore litres of 
ethanol as on 27.03.2022.   
OMCs have also floated Expression of Interests (EoI) to shortlist interested 
bidders who wish to enter into Long-term Off-take Agreement for supply of 
ethanol in the deficit States from upcoming dedicated ethanol plants.   
Used Cooking Oil (UCO) has been identified as a potential raw material for 
biodiesel production and public sector OMCs have floated EoIs for procurement 
of Biodiesel produced from UCO across 300 locations. OMCs have received 
offers for setting up 61 plants with a production capacity of approximately 36 
crore litres per annum for manufacturing Biodiesel from UCO.  
With a view to promote the use of Compressed Bio Gas (CBG) as automotive 
fuel, Sustainable Alternative Towards Affordable Transportation (SATAT) 
initiative has been launched on 01.10.2018 under which OMCs have been 
inviting EoI from potential entrepreneurs to produce CBG. SATAT initiative 
envisages for establishment of 5000 CBG plants across the country with an 
estimated production of 15 MMT CBG per annum by 2023-24. Till 28.2.2022, 
Oil PSUs have released LoIs for establishment of 3160 CBG plants for 
procurement of CBG.  
(c)  The National Policy on Biofuels-2018 provides an indicative target of 20% 
blending of ethanol in petrol and 5% blending of Biodiesel in diesel by 2030.  
The Government has advanced the target of 20% blending of ethanol in petrol 
to 2025-2026.  For the ongoing Ethanol Supply Year (ESY: 2021-22), OMCs 
have already achieved 9.6% blending as on 27 th March, 2022.   
3

(d): In March, 2019, Government has notified the “Pradhan Mantri JI-VAN 
(Jaiv Indhan- Vatavaran Anukool fasal awashesh Nivaran) Yojana” for 
providing financial support to integrated bio-ethanol projects for setting up 
second generation ethanol projects in the country using lignocellulosic biomass 
and other renewable feedstock. The total financial outlay for the scheme is Rs. 
1969.50 crore for the period 2018-19 to 2023-24.  Financial assistance of Rs. 
150 crore each to the four bio-ethanol projects and Rs. 15 crore to one 
demonstration project being set up by Oil CPSEs have been approved under the 
PM JI-VAN Yojana. 
(e): The biofuel policy comprehensively covers various aspects of biofuel 
program including strategy and approach, interventions and enabling 
mechanism, role of stake holders, institutional mechanism, international 
cooperation, etc.  Pursuant to this policy, relevant procedures and processes 
have been put in place.

STATEMENT TO BE LAID ON THE TABLE OF RAJYA SABHA IN RESPECT OF PARTS (a) 
TO (e) OF RAJYA SABHA STARRED QUESTION No.*332 FOR 04.04.2022 REGARDING 
“DEVELOPMENT UNDER NGP”. 
  
(a) Under Namami Gange Programme (NGP),during last three years, a total of 53 new sewerage treatment 
plants have been completed. Details are given atAnnexure-I. 
 
(b) & (c) Under Namami Gange Programme, 160 sewerage infrastructure projects (details are available on 
NMCG website at the link: https://nmcg.nic.in/writereaddata/fileupload/33_Annexure.pdf) have been 
taken up with a sanctioned cost of Rs.24,632.19 crore for creation and rehabilitation of 4,930 Million Litres 
per Day (MLD) of Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) capacity and laying of 5,137 km of sewerage network, 
out of which 78 projects have been completed resulting in creation and rehabilitation of 1,169 MLD of STP 
capacity and laying of 3,908 km sewerage network. 
 
Some of the projects undertaken as part of the Namami Gange Program has faced delays due to a variety of 
factors. Salient reasons for delays in the project are delays in project award due to restructuring, delay in 
achieving financial closure for Hybrid Annuity Model (HAM) projects, delays due to land issues, delay in 
handing over land, delays due to permission from National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) and 
Railways, delays due to Covid-19 etc.  
 
With the various interventions under the Namami Gange Programme since its inception, the river water 
quality of the various erstwhile polluted stretches has improved. As per Central Pollution Control Board 
(CPCB) data as on 2021, none of the Ganga Stretches are in priority category I to IV and only two stretches 
are in Category V. Water Quality Median data for 2021 (January to May), of river Ganga shows that the 
major indicator- Dissolved Oxygen (DO), has been found to be within acceptable limits for primary 
bathing quality across all 84 monitoring locations in the main stem of river Ganga. Similarly, other 
important river health indicators i.e. Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD) and Faecal Coliform (FC) have 
also been found to be within acceptable limits across 68 monitoring locations (out of 84 locations) and 33 
monitoring locations (out of 80 locations) respectively.

Cleaning of river is a continuous process and Government of India is supplementing the efforts of the State 
Government in addressing the challenges of pollution in river Ganga and its tributaries by providing 
financial and technical assistance under Namami Gange Programme. The projects are now taken their pace 
and efforts are now being made to complete the projects by their scheduled completion timeline.
 
 
Considering the need and spread of the Programme, Government of India has further approved Namami 
Gange Mission –II with a budgetary outlay of Rs.22,500 crore till 2026 inter-alia including projects for 
existing liabilities and new projects/interventions.
 
 
(d) In order to expedite implementation of the sewerage infrastructure projects by overcoming the 
bottlenecks and ensure timely completion of projects, the following measures are being taken by National 
Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG): 
 
(i).
 Regular interaction / discussions / site visits and coordination meetings with state agencies by NMCG.  
 
(ii).
 For effective grounding and implementation of projects, a multi-level monitoring mechanism is already 
existing, both at Central and State level. At the Central level, NMCG holds regular review meetings with all 
the concerned State Governments and their Authorities including implementing agencies like Jal Nigam, Jal 
Sansthan etc. to oversee the pace of implementation of infrastructure projects. 
 
(iii).
  Resolving delay in road/railway crossing permissions by conducting high level inter-Ministerial 
meeting with Railways and NHAI. 
 
(iv).  Regular review meetings are also carried out by the Hon’ble Jal Shakti Minister as well as Secretary, 
D/o Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, not only with 
various officers of NMCG and the State Governments but also with the respective Hon’ble Chief Ministers 
or Chief Secretary of States to remove bottlenecks and also for expediting the pace of projects being 
executed at various levels. 
 
(v).
 At State level, State Ganga Committees headed by the Chief Secretaries have been constituted for 
coordinating the Ganga rejuvenation projects between various State agencies and for the first time ever a 
district level mechanism has been set up in the form of District Ganga Committees (DGC) headed by the 
District Magistrate to ensure speedy implementation of interventions and projects and for carrying out 
various activities pertaining to Ganga and its tributaries. 
 
(e) The ‘Namami Gange’ Mission (NGM), a flagship scheme was approved by the Central Government 
under Department of Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation, Ministry of Jal Shakti 
(erstwhile Ministry of WR, RD & GR), GoI in June, 2014 and was launched in May, 2015. It is an 
integrated conservation programme that brings together State governments and central ministries to adopt a 
river-basin approach with a multi-sectoral mandate to address both wastewater quantity and quality aspects. 
Namami Gange is a scientific programme based on Ganga River Basin Management Plan (GRBMP) which 
was prepared by a consortium of 7 IITs led by IIT Kanpur. 
 
Under the Authorities order dated 7
thOctober, 2016, a five-tiered structure was put in place for management, 
conservation and protection of river Ganga basin with National Ganga Council at the apex headed by the 
Hon’ble Prime Minister. At the second level is the Empowered Task Force headed by the Union Minister of 
Jal Shakti tasked with coordinating the Ganga rejuvenation projects with the Ministries/Departments of 
Government of India and with the State Governments.  
 
At State level, State Ganga Committees headed by the Chief Secretaries have been constituted for 
coordinating the Ganga rejuvenation projects between various State agencies and for the first time ever a 
district level mechanism has been set up in the form of District Ganga Committees (DGC) headed by the 
District Magistrate to ensure speedy implementation of interventions and projects and for carrying out 
various activities pertaining to Ganga and its tributaries.   
15

 
The Programme covers 11 States with a focus on major pollution hotspots along the stretch of 97 towns in 
the 5 States of Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Jharkhand. The Programme has learned 
from previous experience and mistakes and included 15 years Operation & Maintenance (O&M) in 
Administrative Approval and Expenditure Sanction (AA&ES) which will lead to long term accountability of 
the operators and improved performance of the built assets.
 
 
Government of India releases funds to National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG), which is the empowered 
nodal agency for implementation of the program nationwide. NMCG  releases funds to State Governments 
/State Programme Management Groups(SPMGs)/ Central Public Sector Undertakings (CPSUSs)/ Other 
Executing Agencies. 
 
National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) has released Rs.11,526.76 crore to State Governments /State 
Programme Management Groups/ CPSUSs/ other Executing Agencies from the financial year 2014-15 
onward till

(a) to (c) Since August, 2019, Government of India, in partnership with States, is implementing 
Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) to make provision of potable tap wate r supply to every rural household 
of the country by 2024.  
In 2019-20, a sum of Rs. 10,000.66 Crore was allocated for the mission and the entire  amount 
was utilized. Similarly, in 2020 -21, Rs. 11,000 Crore was  allocated and utilized. Further, in 
2021-22, as on 30.03.2022, more than Rs. 40,119 Crore has been utilized for implementation of 
the mission. 
At the time of announcement of Jal Jeevan Mission, out of 18.93 Crore rural households, 3.23 
Crore (17%) households were reported to have tap water connections . So far, more than 6. 12 
Crore (31.65%) rural households have been provided with tap water connections in last two and 
half years. Thus, as of date, out of 19.32 Crore rural households in the country, 9.35 Crore 
(48.40%) households are reported to have tap water supply in their homes.

RE
GARDING SMART CITIES IN RAJASTHAN. 
 
(a) to (c): Government of India launched the Smart Cities Mission (SCM) on 25 June 2015. 
100 Smart Cities have been selected through 4 rounds of competition from January 2016 to June 
2018. 4 cities of Rajasthan, i.e., Ajmer, Jaipur, Kota & Udaipur have been selected for 
development as Smart Cities.  
 
As per SCM Guidelines, Central Government will provide financial support to the extent of         
₹ 48,000 crore over five years i.e., on an average ₹ 100 crore per city per year.  An equal amount 
on a matching basis will be contributed by the State Government/Urban Local Body (ULB).  As 
on 4 March 2022, Government of India has released   ₹ 29,213.60 crore for 100 Smart Cities, out 
of which ₹ 25,177.65 crore (86%) has been utilized. The 100 Smart Cities have tendered out 
6,928 projects worth ₹ 1,91,238 crore; work orders have been issued in 6,282 projects worth        
₹ 1,65,503 crore; 3,576 projects worth ₹ 59,958 crore have been completed.  Status of projects in 
Smart Cities of Rajasthan is given in Annexure-I.  Details of funds released under SCM by 
Central Government to States/Union Territories(UTs) & utilization thereof is given in 
Annexure-II. 
 
There is no proposal under consideration of the Government for adding more cities under SCM.  
SCM is aimed at creating replicable models in the 100 Smart Cities which can act as 
`lighthouses’ for other aspiring cities of the country. To support States/UTs and other cities in 
their journey towards becoming Smart Cities, a workbook titled ‘Making a City Smart: Lessons 
from the Smart Cities Mission’ has been released Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs. The 
workbook encapsulates learnings from on-ground implementation of SCM over the past five 
years and can be used by State Governments/UTs to handhold their cities through the What, Why 
and How to make a city smart. The workbook is available online at: 
https://smartnet.niua.org/content.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) to (e) OF STARRED QUESTION 
NO. *337 TO BE ANSWERED ON 04.04.2022 REGARDING “INTER-STATE WATER 
DISPUTES”. 
  
(a)
 Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956, as amended, prescribes procedure only for 
adjudication of disputes relating to waters of inter-State rivers and river valley thereof. When any 
request under section 3 of the Act is received from any State Government in respect of any water 
dispute and the Central Government is of opinion that the water dispute cannot be settled by 
negotiations, the Central Government under section 4 (1) of the Act shall, within a period not 
exceeding one year from the date of receipt of such request, by notification in the Official Gazette, 
constitute a Water Disputes Tribunal for the adjudication of the water dispute.
 
  
(b) to (e)  The Detailed Project Report (DPR) of Upper Bhadra Project was received in the Central 
water Commission (CWC) in August, 2015 for planned utilization of 29.90 TMC (thousand million 
cubic feet). As per the DPR, the project envisages lifting of 17.40 TMC of water in the 1st stage from 
Tunga to Bhadra and lifting 29.90 TMC of water in the 2nd stage from Bhadra to Tunnel near 
Ajjampura in Tungabhadra sub-basin of Krishna basin. The project proposes to use water from K-8 
(Tungabhadra) sub-basin in Krishna basin. 
 
  
As per Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal (KWDT-1) Award, State of Karnataka has been allocated 734 
TMC of Krishna waters. The Clause XV of the order of KWDT-1 states that, “
Nothing in the Order of 
this Tribunal shall impair the right or power or authority of any State to regulate within its 
boundaries  the use of water, or to enjoy the benefit of waters within that State in a manner not 
inconsistent with the Order of this Tribunal
”.  
  
The State of Karnataka prepared a Master Plan in 2002 indicating project-wise allocation of 734 TMC 
of waters. In the said Master Plan, allocation to projects in K-8 (Tungabhadra) sub-basin has been kept 
as 311.90 TMC, i.e., well within the limit on the utilization of water from K-8 (Tungabhadra) sub-
basin of 320 TMC, as per the Final Order of KWDT. Out of 734 TMC of water, 23 TMC of water has 
been allocated to Upper Bhadra Project. As per the DPR, out of 23 TMC for Upper Bhadra Project, 1.5 
TMC is to be utilized for Ubrani Amrathapura LIS. Thus, out of 734 TMC allocated by KWDT-I, 21.5 
TMC is planned for utilization in Upper Bhadra Project. Further, as per decision of Godavari Water 
Disputes Tribunal (GWDT), 21 TMC of water is allocated to Karnataka in lieu of Godavari Diversion 
Scheme of Andhra Pradesh. As intimated by the Government of Karnataka, the Master Plan has been 
revised restricting the quantity available from Godavari diversion to 21 TMC. Out of this 21 TMC, an 
allocation of 2.4 TMC of water for the Upper Bhadra Project is included in the Master Plan. 
Subsequently, State of Karnataka vide Order dated 27.11.2019 has accorded its approval for 
accounting 6.0 TMC of water under Upper Bhadra Project from the overall allocation of Minor 
Irrigation (MI) in K-8 (Tungabhadra) & K-9 (Vedavathy) sub-basins of Krishna Basin. Thus the total 
allocation to Upper Bhadra Project becomes 29.9 (21.5 + 2.4 + 6) TMC. 
 
  
The project was considered by the Advisory Committee of Department of Water Resources, River 
Development and Ganga Rejuvenation in its 147th meeting held on 24.12.2020 and as per the minutes 
of the said meeting,  the project is as per the Award of KWDT-I as well as  GWDT. Since the planned 
utilization of the project was within the allocation of water to Karnataka, consultation with other basin 
States was not necessary as per the extant guidelines for clearance of projects from inter-State angle.

(i) Methodology for auction of coal and lignite mines / blocks for sale of coal / lignite on 
revenue sharing basis and tenure of coking coal linkage was issued on 28.05.2020 and 
modified vide order dated 24.11.2021.
  
  
(ii) Amendments have been made in  the Coal Mines (Special Provisions) Act, 2015 
[CMSP Act] and the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Act, 1957 
[MMDR Act] through Mineral Laws Amendment Act, 2020 enacted on 13.03.2020 to 
ensure wider participation and competition in auction of co al mines. The amendments in 
the Acts would enable the following:  
 
 Allocation of coal blocks for composite prospecting license -cum-mining lease which 
will help in increasing of the inventory of coal/lignite blocks for allocation. 
 Repetitive and redundant p rovision requiring previous approval of Central 
government even in cases where the allocation or reservation of coal/lignite block has 
been made by the Central Govt. itself has been done away with. 
 Provided flexibility to the Central Govt. in deciding the end use of Schedule II and III 
coal mines under the CMSP Act. 
 Companies which do not possess any prior coal mining experience in India  can now 
participate in auction of coal blocks. 
(iii) Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Act, 2021,  carried 
out amendments in MMDR Act 1957. The said amendments necessitated amendments in 
the Mineral Concession (Amendment) Rules, 1960  (MCR, 1960) . Hence, MCR, 1960 
have been appropriately amended vide the Mineral Concession (Amendment) Rules, 2021 
which have been notified vide gazette notification on 01.10.2021. 
 
With insertion of Rule 27A in the MCR, 1960, lessee of captive mine is allowed to 
sell coal or lignite up to 50% of the total coal or lignite produced in a financial year after 
meeting the requirement of the end use plant linked with the mine. This provision is not 
applicable to a power project awarded on the basis of competitive bid for tariff including 
Ultra Mega Power Projects.  
 
Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette and for the reasons to 
be recorded in writing, increase the said percentage of coal or lignite that may be sold by 
a Government company or corporation beyond 50%. 
 
(iv) Government of India has tentatively identified 13 discontinued mines of Coal India 
Limited to be operated in partnership with private companies on Revenue Sharing Model 
basis. Details of the above 13 mines are at Annexure. 
 
 
(b): Methodology for auction of coal and lignite mines/blocks on revenue sharing basis was 
issued on 28.05.2020 for sale of coal/lignite and modified vide order dated 24.11.2021. 
Salient features of the Methodology are as under:  
 Based on Revenue sharing mechanism. Floor percentage at 4%. 
 Applicable to fully explored as well as partially explored coal blocks. 
 Upfront amount is based on value of estimated geological reserves. 
50

 Successful Bidder to pay monthly revenue share based on percentage of revenue share 
quoted, total quantity of coal and notional or actual price whichever is higher. 
 Incentives for early production, gasification and liquefaction of coal. 
 Exploitation of Coal Bed Methane (CBM) is allowed. 
 No restriction on the sale and/ or utilisation of coal. More flexibility in coal 
production schedule. 
If the successful bidder consumes the coal produced either in its own plant(s) or plant of 
its holding, subsidiary, affiliate, associate for coal gasification or liquefaction or sells the coal 
for coal gasification or liquefaction process, a rebate of 50% on the percentage revenue share 
quoted by the successful bidder will be allowed on the total quantity of coal consumed or sold 
or both for gasification or liquefaction on an yearly basis, subject to the stipulated conditions. 
  
(c): The following steps have been taken by Government to reduce the import of coal and 
increase coal production in the country: 
i. Commercial Auction of coal on revenue share mechanism: As a step towards Atma 
Nirbhar Bharat, Ministry of Coal has launched auction of coal mines for commercial 
mining in June 2020. Total 4 rounds of auction have been launched in which total 292 
coal mines were offered. In these 4 rounds of auction, 42 coal mines have been 
successfully auctioned in 3 rounds and Agreements have been executed in respect of 27 
coal blocks.   
 
ii. Allowed sale of excess coal production : With insertion of Rule 27A in the MCR, 
1960, lessee of captive mine is allowed to sell coal or lignite up to such percent (50%) of 
the total coal or lignite produced in a financial year after meeting the requirement of the 
end use plant linked with the mine. This is applicable for both the private and public 
sector captive mines. With this amendment, the Government has paved the way for 
releasing of additional coal in the market by greater utilization of mining capacities of 
captive coal and lignite blocks, which were being only partly utilized owing to limited 
production of coal for meeting their captive needs. 
iii. Single Window Clearance:  
The Union government has already launched Single 
Window Clearance portal on 11.01.2021 for the coal sector to speed up the 
operationalisation of coal mines. It is a unified platform that facilitates grant of 
clearances and approvals required for starting a coal mine in India. Now, the complete 
process shall be facilitated through Single Window Clearance Portal, which will map not 
only the relevant application formats, but also process flow for grant of approval or 
clearances. 
iv.
 Coal India Limited (CIL) has envisaged a coal production programme of one Billion 
Tonne from CIL mines. CIL has taken the following steps to achieve the target of 
augmentation of coal production capacity: 
 15 Projects identified with a Capacity of about 160 MTPA (Million Tonnes per 
Annum) to be operated by Mine Developer cum Operator mode. 
 Capacity addition through special dispensation in Environment Clearance under 
clause 7(ii) of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) 2006. 
 CIL has taken steps to upgrade the mechanized coal transportation and loading system 
under 'First Mile Connectivity' projects

CHEAP AIR JOURNEY
 
 
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:-
 
(a) whether Government has formulated any scheme to facilitate cheaper air
journey to the general public and, if so, the details thereof;
(b) if not, the steps proposed to be taken by Government for operation of cheaper
domestic flights;
(c) the names of the States in which Government proposes to implement this
system; and
(d) the details of the rates likely to be made applicable, State-wise?
 
ANSWER
 
MINISTER OF STATE IN THE MINISTRY OF CIVIL AVIATION
 
 (GEN. (DR) V. K. SINGH (RETD))
 
 
(a) to (d): Ministry of Civil Aviation has launched Regional Connectivity Scheme
(RCS) - UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik) on 21-10-2016 to stimulate regional
air connectivity and making air travel affordable to the masses. Under UDAN, 948
valid routes have been awarded across length and breadth in the country, of which,
415 routes connecting 66 unserved and underserved airports including 8 Heliports
& 2 water aerodromes have been operationalized.
 
Besides Viability Gap Funding (VGF), other concessions from Central, State
Governments and airport operators are extended to Selected Airline Operators
(SAOs) to encourage operations from unserved/underserved
airports/heliports/water aerodromes and to keep the air fare affordable under the
UDAN scheme. While launching the UDAN Scheme in 2016, the Government had
capped the Airfare at Rs. 2500 for a distance of approximately 500 km (equivalent
to one-hour flight) per seat under Regional Connectivity routes. The capping is
subject to indexation as per the formula specified in the UDAN Scheme document.
UDAN is a Pan-India Scheme and routes are awarded connecting length and
breadth of the Country.
 
Under the provisions of Sub Rule(1) of Rule 135 of the Aircraft Rules, 1937, every

Rule (2) of Rule 135 of the Aircraft Rules, 1937 as long as fare charged by them is

However, fare capping was put in place by the Government during the COVID-19
